title: Bill of Lading Intake Checklist
subtitle: Bill Of Lading Intake: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Bill of Lading Intake Checklist covers received transport document, shipment terms, commodity lines, parties, and exceptions. The transport document intake coordinator records Bill Of Lading Intake criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Bill of Lading Intake Checklist keeps Bill Of Lading Intake exceptions visible until the transport document intake coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Bill of Lading Intake Checklist at shipping office, receiving office, dispatch system, and document repository. Document received transport document, shipment terms, commodity lines, parties, and exceptions identity before Bill Of Lading Intake begins. Compare received transport document, shipment terms, commodity lines, parties, and exceptions findings with stated Bill Of Lading Intake criteria; route unresolved Bill Of Lading Intake issues to transport documentation reviewer. For Bill of Lading Intake Checklist, confirm requirements for Bill Of Lading Intake. Ask transport documentation reviewer to review Bill Of Lading Intake conditions beyond the transport document intake coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Bill Of Lading Intake, identify responsible parties, shipping office, receiving office, dispatch system, and document repository, and the linked received transport document, shipment terms, commodity lines, parties, and exceptions source.

fields.label: Document number, version, and received time
Shipper, consignee, carrier, and billing party
Shipment, commodity, package, weight, class, and reference identifiers

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Bill Of Lading Intake facts for received transport document, shipment terms, commodity lines, parties, and exceptions; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Bill Of Lading Intake inspection checks
items: Special handling or classification review status
System entry and retained source copy

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Bill Of Lading Intake, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Transport Document Intake Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Bill Of Lading Intake when document integrity, party identity, shipment reconciliation, or required qualified review remains unresolved. Retain the available Bill Of Lading Intake proof and route unresolved received transport document, shipment terms, commodity lines, parties, and exceptions scope to transport document intake coordinator.
